title: Eco-friendly fabrication of Ag/Fe2O3 and Ag/Co nanocomposites via Anabasis articulata: GC-MS, phytochemical analysis, antioxidant, antimicrobial, and insecticidal activities
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,39336-39354

Green-synthesized Ag/Fe2O3 and Ag/Co NCs using Anabasis articulata extract showed strong antioxidant, antibacterial, and insecticidal activities, highlighting their dual eco-friendly potential for antimicrobial and crop protection applications.
